name: @wardrobe/frontend
description: A private, account-based AI wardrobe assistant.

scripts.check:architecture: node scripts/architecture-audit.mjs --check && node scripts/check-project-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/source-consolidation-audit.mjs --check
scripts.architecture:build: npm run build -w @wardrobe/contracts && npm run build -w @wardrobe/backend && npm run build -w @wardrobe/ai-orchestration && npm run build -w @wardrobe/worker
scripts.architecture:typecheck: npm run build -w @wardrobe/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @wardrobe/backend && npm run typecheck -w @wardrobe/ai-orchestration && npm run typecheck -w @wardrobe/worker
scripts.architecture:test: npm run build -w @wardrobe/contracts && npm run test -w @wardrobe/backend && npm run test -w @wardrobe/ai-orchestration && npm run test -w @wardrobe/worker
scripts.check:quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run architecture:typecheck && npm run check:architecture && npm run test && npm run architecture:test && npm run build && npm run architecture:build && npm run legacy:build
scripts.check: npm run check:quality && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
